The UID-shape guard BARE_UID_RE is NOT defensive and does carry M7: without it a non-UID filename stem would resolve, widening the fallback into a filename resolver (V4 locks that). M8 is the order mutant the plan gate required: it freezes the index the moment the first candidate is collected, i.e. registration would no longer wait for a complete map — it must redden V3 and ONLY V3.
